answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16037 Country: India Title: One of my friends is diabetes patient. Tow years before the doctor told him to not take fast. Still now he feels difficulty to take fast. Can he give compensation for fast? Question: One of my friends is diabetes patient. Tow years before the doctor told him to not take fast. Still now he feels difficulty to take fast. Can he give compensation for fast? Answer ID: 16037 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1712/D=237/K=1430) If a Muslim religious and expert doctor prescribes that fasting is harmful, he can leave the fasting. But, once he is able to fast (in shorter days of winter), he will have to make qadha of the same. But if he is suffering from a disease which does not allow him to fast in any season and he is in a stage of life that recovery is unexpected, he can give fidyah (expiation) of the same. But, he was able to fast in future, he will be asked to keep those fast again. Therefore, if he expects to keep fasts, he should make a will of fidyah in case he could not fast and died and inform the family members of the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
